# Shakti Ranjan Debata

> Portfolio of Shakti Ranjan Debata, a software engineer who builds backend systems with Node.js, Express.js, and TypeScript.

The public JSON endpoints accept GET requests. Each response includes `isSuccess`, `message`, and `data`. The `data` field contains the portfolio content.

## JSON endpoints

- [Profile, education, and contact links](https://shaktiranjan.dev/api/me)
- [Professional experience](https://shaktiranjan.dev/api/experiences)
- [Technical skills](https://shaktiranjan.dev/api/skills)
- [Selected projects](https://shaktiranjan.dev/api/projects)

## Portfolio pages

- [Home and profile](https://shaktiranjan.dev/)
- [Experience](https://shaktiranjan.dev/experiences)
- [Skills](https://shaktiranjan.dev/skills)
- [Projects](https://shaktiranjan.dev/projects)

## Optional
